intro: A sharp tooth harvested from the predatory nightsabers roaming the wild branches of Teldrassil. While a common trophy of the hunt, these fangs are also sought out as raw reagents by local woodland residents with questionable motives.

p: Nightsabers are among the deadliest natural predators native to northern Kalimdor, revered by the night elves for their agility, ferocity, and deep spiritual connection to Elune. Across the great boughs of Teldrassil, these feline beasts hunt in the shadows beneath the canopy. Striking one down yields sharp fangs that serve as undeniable proof of a hunter's skill, though certain unsavory figures in the forest seek them out for less noble ritual purposes.
